post.originalText:
Holy shit. I think we’re basically at AGI.

I gave one prompt to Claude Opus 5.5: “make a music video for my song", and with no other instructions it listened to the track, timed every lyric and identified every piano note and built this music video in code.

wtf! https://t.co/dUGL69aM2y
